copy.headline: The Dahlia — a sculpted mini blooming with 3D rosettes.
copy.description: A high-rise mini whose surface blooms: row upon row of hand-mounted 3D dahlia petals over a structured base, in the deep house wine. Pair it with the Dahlia Tank for the full look, or let it carry a simple knit on its own.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Each rosette is individually mounted — the Dahlia is the most handwork in the capsule.
copy.editorialQuote: Half of the Dahlia language — a skirt in full bloom.

fabric.drapeDescription: Sculptural hold — the petals carry the movement
fabric.finish: Matte wine ground with raised petal relief
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store folded with tissue between petals.
